The Project model parent_chat_id is properly Optional[str]=None (server.py:235) and persisted on generate-complete-app (server.py:2435-2446).

No 4s spinner — this delivers the requested ChatGPT-style token-by-token UX.

Frontend DeviceManager.jsx:284-295 renders the dropdown with the 3 required data-testids: approve-as-user-{key_id}, approve-as-modo-{key_id}, approve-as-admin-{key_id} — gated by allowedApprovalRoles (lines 67-95) which mirrors the backend hierarchy. Cleanly aligned client/server.
